scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/worker && uv sync && uv run playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,demo,worker -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/demo" "cd apps/worker && uv run worker"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && cd apps/worker && uv run pytest
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspaces && cd apps/worker && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
